text:
amanda: Heads-up — CS reported a customer saw saved searches from Org A show up briefly in Org B after a fast workspace switch. Sensitive rows visible for ~2s :grimacing:
leo: I can repro locally. Login user with two orgs, quick-switch from A -> B using the header dropdown, then open Saved Searches. Results flash A then settle to B.
soumya: Looking at ingress logs: requests coming to console have X-Org-ID header == previous org even though session cookie points to new org. Router cached a header-binding for that connection.
leo: Paste from request dump:
```
GET /console/api/saved-searches
Cookie: session=eyJ...; org=org-B
X-Org-ID: org-A
Host: console.internal
```
console-service resolving selected_org uses header if present — so a transient bleed.
marco: Oof. We allowed X-Org-ID for some debug/admin flows and added a router affinity cache for headers. Quick-switch doesn’t clear the header on the client-side before the next request hits the same keep-alive connection.
soumya: Options for fixes: (1) client: clear X-Org-ID when switching workspaces (fast, but brittle), (2) gateway: strip X-Org-ID if a session cookie exists and ties to another org (defensive), (3) console-service: prefer cookie over header (last-resort).
tim: Strong vote for server-side defenses. Client bugs will crop up; we should make the gateway or service authoritative.
leo: Implementation idea: add a gateway filter that compares Cookie.org vs X-Org-ID. If mismatch, drop X-Org-ID and emit metric `org.header.mismatch`. Also add a short-lived log sampling to capture examples.
amanda: Also need to think quota/telemetry attribution — if a request is misattributed to org-A for those 2s, billing/alerts could be wrong.
soumya: Metric check: ~0.02% of requests in last 24h had header/cookie mismatch. Mostly from quick-switch UI flows. Need a backfill plan to reassign token counts for that window if possible.
marco: Plan I'm proposing:
- gateway: strip X-Org-ID when Cookie.org present and mismatch (PR today)
- console-service: change precedence to favor cookie over header (PR tomorrow)
- devx: patch quick-switch client to clear header on switch (follow-up)
I'll own gateway + service PRs.
tim: deploy-bot: schedule canary for gateway filter.
deploy-bot: canary started: gateway-filter v1.2 -> canary hosts 3/30 at 15:00 UTC
leo: Confirmed on canary: repro fails, no header stickiness on repeated quick-switches. Metric `org.header.mismatch` incremented and shows expected drops.
amanda: Filing a CS note + internal incident with summary and impact. Also flag billing team to check attribution for the small window.
marco: Will open the PRs now and add test asserting header strip on keep-alive reused conn.
soumya: Also add an integration test that simulates N requests over a single connection while switching org cookie mid-stream.
amanda: Thanks everyone. Great catch. Follow-up actions: postmortem, customer outreach, small billing reconciliation. :tada:
